item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
AULA HORIZONTE

Beginner English

Build confidence in everyday conversations: introduce yourself, ask for directions and arrange simple plans.

Who is it for?

Adults taking their first steps in English or returning after a long break.

What we will practise

  • Introductions and everyday vocabulary
  • Simple questions, listening and pronunciation
  • Practical conversations for travel and daily life

Before you begin

No previous knowledge required. Bring a notebook; sample materials are provided in class.

Beginner French

Start speaking French through useful situations, pronunciation practice and short conversations.

  • Shopping, food and getting around
  • Simple descriptions and short dialogues

AULA HORIZONTE

Academic support

Organise study time, understand key concepts and practise exercises at your own pace.

Who is it for?

Young people and adults who need help with study habits or specific subjects.

What we will practise

  • Study planning and manageable goals
  • Guided exercises in agreed subjects
  • Revision strategies and progress reviews

Before you begin

Bring the materials you currently use. We agree on goals after an initial conversation; results are not guaranteed.
